articles.mainIdea: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Dip As Lower Yields Meet Cost Pressures
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Dip As Lower Yields Meet Cost Pressures. The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Wednesday, Jan, 7 2026 US stock futures are slightly softer this morning, with the main S&P 500 contracts edging lower while volatility gauges like VIX futures sit around 16.3. The big global story is falling government bond yields in Europe and Poland, which point to easier borrowing costs for households and companies. At the same time, the US Services PMI at 52.5 and Composite PMI at 52.7 show the economy is still growing, just at a slower pace... Related tickers mentioned: SNDK, SOFI, WDC, ^GSPC.
